topics.label: Passive voice
topics.focus: Say what happens to something, not who does it — like ‘Our kitchen was painted last spring.’

topics.label: Tenses
topics.focus: Pick the tense that fits the time — like ‘I’ve known her since we were six.’

topics.label: Conditionals
topics.focus: Match the ‘if’ part to its result — like ‘If it snows, we’ll build a snowman.’

topics.label: Past modals
topics.focus: Guess, judge or regret the past — like ‘She must have missed the bus.’

topics.label: Comparatives
topics.focus: Compare two or more things — like ‘This one is far lighter than mine.’

topics.label: Reported speech
topics.focus: Tell someone what another person said — like ‘He said he was hungry.’

topics.label: Linking words
topics.focus: Join two ideas with the right link — like ‘Although it was late, we kept walking.’

topics.label: Inversion
topics.focus: Put the verb before the subject — like ‘Not once did she complain.’

topics.label: Gerunds & infinitives
topics.focus: Choose the -ing form, to, or the plain verb — like ‘I miss living by the sea.’

topics.label: Miscellaneous
topics.focus: A mix of B2 grammar — read each sentence carefully before you answer.
